arStrings.szText:
While in a {c_important}Nightmare Dungeon{/c}, killing {c_important}Elites{/c} and {c_important}Champions{/c} grants you stacks of {c_important}Conviction{/c}.

Getting hit by an {c_important}Elite{/c} or {c_important}Champion{/c} causes you to lose a stack of {c_important}Conviction{/c}.

A {c_important}Conviction Chest{/c} appears at the end of the dungeon that grants rewards for each remaining {c_important}Conviction{/c}. This chest has a higher than normal chance to award {c_unique}Attuned Primordial Dust{/c}.
